basic_details.scholarship_name: Dalhousie University International Graduate Research Awards & Nova Scotia Graduate Scholarships
basic_details.offering_entity: Faculty of Graduate Studies (FGS), Dalhousie University & Province of Nova Scotia
basic_details.major_restrictions: Faculty of Computer Science, Faculty of Engineering (Electrical & Computer, Mechanical, Civil, Chemical, Biomedical), Faculty of Science (Oceanography, Physics, Chemistry, Biology), and Faculty of Medicine.
basic_details.number_of_awards_total: ~120 to 170 graduate research scholarships and departmental fellowships awarded annually
basic_details.number_of_awards_pakistan: Open internationally on merit; Pakistani graduate researchers frequently secure funding in Computer Science, Oceanography, and Engineering (~12 to 22 awards annually)
basic_details.duration_of_scholarship: Up to 2 years for Master's; up to 4 years for PhD
basic_details.monthly_stipend_amount: CAD 22,000 to 30,000 / year total guaranteed funding package (CAD 15,000 to 20,000 / yr scholarship plus Graduate Teaching & Research Assistantships; approx. CAD 1,830 to 2,500 / month; ~PKR 375,000 to 510,000 / month)

nationality_requirements: International students of all nationalities including Pakistan as well as Canadian citizens/PR
eligibility_requirements.age_limit_notes: No age restriction; evaluation based on undergraduate and graduate academic record and research potential.
eligibility_requirements.academic_qualifications: Recognized 16-year Bachelor's degree with minimum admission GPA of 3.70 / 4.00 (or first-class standing / 80%+) for Master's; 18-year Master's degree with minimum GPA 3.70 / 4.00 for PhD from an HEC-recognized university.
eligibility_requirements.grading_conversion_notes: Minimum admission GPA of 3.7 / 4.0 (A- standing) in the final two years of undergraduate study.
eligibility_requirements.subject_background_prerequisites: Undergraduate degree in computer science, software engineering, physics, oceanography, or related scientific discipline.
eligibility_requirements.current_education_status: Graduated or final-year students completing qualifications prior to September enrollment.
eligibility_requirements.work_experience_notes: Prior scientific research publications, conference presentations, or industrial software experience strongly valued.
eligibility_requirements.language_notes: IELTS Academic minimum 7.0 overall (no subscore below 6.5) or TOEFL iBT minimum 92 (no subscore below 20) mandatory for Computer Science and Engineering.
eligibility_requirements.special_eligibility_categories: Candidates must be admitted to an eligible thesis-based graduate program and nominated by their academic department.
eligibility_requirements.previous_scholarship_restrictions: Subject to Dalhousie FGS award policies on concurrent scholarship holding.

tuition_fee.details: 100% full international tuition differential fee covered via departmental tuition bursaries and FGS International Tuition Fee Awards.
tuition_fee.amount: 100% covered (~CAD 9,000 to 11,500 / year value; ~PKR 1,850,000 to 2,350,000 / year)

admission_application_fee.details: Non-refundable graduate application fee of CAD 115 paid directly via online application.

accommodation.details: Off-campus apartment rental or university residence in Halifax arranged independently; funded comfortably through guaranteed living stipend.
accommodation.amount: Funded from stipend (~CAD 850 to 1,250 / month rent in Halifax)

monthly_stipend.details: Guaranteed annual living stipend of CAD 22,000 (Master's) to CAD 28,000+ (PhD) composed of departmental awards, GTA, and GRA funding.
monthly_stipend.amount: CAD 1,830 to 2,330 / month living stipend (~PKR 375,000 to 480,000 / mo)

airfare.details: International travel flights to Halifax are self-funded by the student.

visa_fee.details: Canadian Study Permit (~CAD 150) and biometrics fee (~CAD 85) paid directly to IRCC.

health_insurance.details: Dalhousie Student Union (DSU) International Health Plan provides comprehensive primary and emergency medical healthcare for international students.

food_allowance.details: Groceries and dining expenses funded out of monthly living stipend.

books_and_materials_allowance.details: Faculty of Computer Science and Engineering provide dedicated research desk space, high-performance computing clusters, and complete university library access.

research_funding_conference_grant.details: FGS Conference Travel Grants provide up to CAD 1,000 to 1,500 per year for presenting peer-reviewed research papers at conferences.
research_funding_conference_grant.amount: Up to CAD 1,500 / year travel grant

travel_transit_allowance.details: Halifax Transit Universal Bus Pass (U-Pass) included in student fees providing unlimited public bus and harbor ferry travel across Halifax Regional Municipality.

university_and_program_options.single_or_multiple_universities: Single Canadian U15 research university (Dalhousie University).
participating_institutions: Dalhousie University (Studley, Carleton, and Sexton Campuses, Halifax, Nova Scotia, Canada)
university_and_program_options.university_rankings_scope: QS World University Rankings #275, member of Canada's U15 research group, Atlantic Canada's premier research powerhouse, world leader in Ocean Sciences, Clean Energy, and Big Data.
available_majors: PhD in Computer Science (Big Data, Machine Learning, HCI, Visual Analytics)
MASc / PhD in Electrical and Computer Engineering
MSc / PhD in Oceanography and Marine Biology
MSc / PhD in Physics and Atmospheric Science
MSc / PhD in Chemistry and Materials
university_and_program_options.admission_requirements_summary: Bachelor's / Master's degree with minimum GPA 3.7 / 4.0 in final 2 years, verified transcripts, IELTS 7.0+ (no subscore < 6.5) or TOEFL 92+, three academic recommendation letters, CV, statement of research intent, and faculty supervisor confirmation.
university_and_program_options.easiest_hardest_institutions_guidance: Faculty of Computer Science and Institute for Big Data Analytics are highly selective; securing prospective supervisor commitment prior to applying is strongly recommended.
university_and_program_options.strategic_program_match_advice: Focus on Dalhousie's strategic research strengths including ocean tech, AI visual analytics, clean battery tech (Jeff Dahn lab), and health data science.

application_process_roadmap.portal_system_name: Dalhousie University Graduate Online Application Portal
application_process_roadmap.account_creation_instructions: Register on the Dalhousie graduate portal, choose thesis graduate program, list potential supervisors, upload academic transcripts, English score report, CV, and statement of research intent, and pay CAD 115 fee.
step_by_step_workflow: Step 1: Explore faculty directory and contact potential research supervisors with CV and research interests.
Step 2: Obtain valid IELTS (7.0+) or TOEFL (92+) score report.
Step 3: Submit application on Dalhousie online portal and pay CAD 115 fee.
Step 4: Upload official academic transcripts, statement of intent, and curriculum vitae.
Step 5: Provide 3 referee email addresses; referees receive automated links to submit confidential assessments.
Step 6: Departmental graduate committee conducts admissions review and nominates top applicants for FGS and Nova Scotia Graduate Scholarships.
Step 7: Candidate receives formal admission offer with guaranteed minimum funding letter.
Step 8: Accept offer, receive Provincial Attestation Letter (PAL), and apply for Canadian Study Permit.
application_process_roadmap.university_vs_scholarship_routing: Integrated Departmental Nomination: Admitted thesis-based graduate students are automatically evaluated for funding packages without separate application.
application_process_roadmap.recommendation_letters_submission_method: Submitted online by referees via automated secure electronic appraisal forms.
application_process_roadmap.personal_statement_prompts: Statement of research intent (1 to 2 pages) describing research experience, academic goals, and alignment with Dalhousie faculty research.
application_process_roadmap.study_plan_research_proposal_requirement: 1 to 2-page research outline highlighting potential thesis directions and methodological knowledge.
application_process_roadmap.cv_format_requirements: Standard academic CV detailing education, GPA, research projects, publications, and technical competencies.
application_process_roadmap.interview_format_details: Supervisory technical interview via Zoom to discuss research methodology and prospective lab projects.
application_process_roadmap.standardized_tests: IELTS Academic 7.0+ or TOEFL iBT 92+ mandatory; GRE optional.
application_process_roadmap.attestation_requirements: HEC Pakistan and MoFA Pakistan verified transcripts required upon conditional admission.
application_process_roadmap.translation_requirements: Certified English translation of all non-English transcripts.
application_process_roadmap.final_submission_method: 100% digital submission via Dalhousie application system.

important_dates_timeline.application_deadline: January 15 (Early / International round) / February 15 (Final department round)
important_dates_timeline.annual_cycle_notes: Main intake starts in September (Fall). Selected engineering departments also offer January intake.

selection_process_and_weights.academic_weight: 35% (Prior academic GPA, course grades in core subjects)
selection_process_and_weights.research_experience_weight: 40% (Prior research projects, publications, thesis quality, coding acumen)
selection_process_and_weights.work_experience_weight: 5% (Industry software engineering or research lab experience)
selection_process_and_weights.test_scores_weight: 0% (English test is a mandatory qualification threshold)
selection_process_and_weights.selection_panel_composition: Departmental Graduate Admissions Committee and Prospective Faculty Supervisor.
selection_process_and_weights.evaluation_methodology: Competitive evaluation matching top academic candidates with funded faculty research laboratories.

competitiveness_profile.total_annual_applicants: ~3,500 to 5,000 thesis graduate applicants across faculties
competitiveness_profile.total_scholarships_awarded: ~120 to 170 fully funded thesis research positions annually
competitiveness_profile.acceptance_rate_pakistan: ~4.0% to 6.5% for applicants with GPA >= 3.7 and research background
competitiveness_profile.typical_successful_applicant_gpa: Undergraduate CGPA >= 3.70 / 4.00, solid research thesis or published conference papers
competitiveness_profile.typical_academic_and_research_profile: Top-tier graduates from recognized universities with strong programming/laboratory skills, clear research focus, and supervisor backing.
competitiveness_profile.common_backgrounds_of_winners: Graduates from premier Pakistani universities (NUST, FAST, LUMS, GIKI, UET, Quaid-i-Azam, COMSATS).
competitiveness_profile.high_representation_countries: Canada, Pakistan, India, China, Iran, Nigeria, Bangladesh, USA, Germany.

fake_websites_and_scams: Only apply through official Dalhousie portal at dal.ca.
Dalhousie never works with unauthorized commercial agents.
red_flags_and_warnings.application_fee_warning: Application fee of CAD 115 is paid strictly through the secure online application gateway.
red_flags_and_warnings.agent_and_intermediary_warnings: Dalhousie University evaluates thesis graduate applicants directly through academic departments.
hidden_costs_breakdown: Canadian Study Permit & biometrics fee: CAD 235 (~PKR 48,000).
Initial relocation flight to Halifax: ~PKR 250,000 to 350,000.
misleading_claims_debunked: Myth: Halifax has no major tech industry. Reality: Halifax is one of Canada's fastest-growing tech and ocean-tech clusters, hosting leading research facilities.
Myth: You do not need supervisor contact. Reality: Securing early supervisor interest dramatically improves admission probability and funding certainty.
official_vs_unofficial_discrepancies: Third-party sites frequently post obsolete funding numbers; current verified funding package is CAD 22,000 (MSc) to CAD 28,000+ (PhD).

scholarship_obligations_and_terms.minimum_gpa_maintenance: Must maintain a minimum cumulative graduate GPA of 3.3 / 4.0 (B+ average) throughout each academic term.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.attendance_requirements: Full-time resident study in Halifax and continuous registration across all terms.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.academic_progress_monitoring: Annual progress review submitted by supervisory committee to Department Graduate Coordinator and FGS.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.work_restrictions_during_study: Teaching Assistant (TA) or Research Assistant (RA) duties are capped at maximum 12 hours/week during academic terms.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.home_country_return_obligation: None; graduates are eligible for a 3-year Canadian Post-Graduation Work Permit (PGWP).
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.service_obligations_or_bonds: Obligation to fulfill assigned Teaching Assistant or Research Assistant duties.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.repayment_clawback_conditions: Funding terminated if student withdraws, switches to unapproved part-time study, or fails required academic milestones.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.rules_for_changing_major: Requires approval from graduate program committee and faculty supervisor.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.extension_policy: Funding beyond normal degree timeline is subject to supervisor grant availability and satisfactory progress.
